job.question: In the Boston Retirement System's investment consulting services proposal questionnaire (Attachment 3), how many current public fund client references must be listed, and what minimum asset size must those clients have?
job.expected_facts: Up to 10 current public fund clients with assets greater than $1 billion for whom similar work was performed, giving name, contact, telephone number, asset values, number of years the client has retained the firm and the service used.
job.acceptance: Accept up to ten / no more than ten and >$1bn. Contact-detail fields and similar-work context are supplementary; exactly ten or at least $1bn is not equivalent.

reviews.reason: This is a City of Hartford investment consultant RFP, not the Boston Retirement System’s Attachment 3. Its client-reference requests and asset threshold differ, so it does not support the question’s requirements.
quotes: CITY OF HARTFORD TREASURER’S OFFICE MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT FUND of the CITY of HARTFORD and CITY of HARTFORD OPEB TRUST
25. Please provide three references along with the corresponding contact information from public defined benefit pension fund clients that are similar in size to the MERF.
The Proposer shall currently serve as consultant for at least five public pension funds each with over $1.5 billion in assets.
